articles.title: Downtown Boston was buzzing in July. Here’s a look at the numbers.
articles.description:
The World Cup, Sail Boston, 250th celebrations, and social districts helped bring more visitors and economic activity downtown.

The post Downtown Boston was buzzing in July. Here’s a look at the numbers. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Downtown Boston saw increased visitor numbers due to events like the World Cup and Sail Boston.
250th celebrations contributed to a significant boost in local economic activity throughout July.
Social districts enhanced community engagement, benefiting local businesses and residents.

articles.title: Healey temporarily restricts kratom sales statewide
articles.description:
State officials are temporarily designating all forms of kratom as Schedule I substances, which have a “high potential for abuse.”

The post Healey temporarily restricts kratom sales statewide appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Healey designates all kratom forms as Schedule I substances effective immediately.
This action affects all kratom sales across Massachusetts, impacting local retailers.
Residents may face limited access to kratom products due to the new restrictions.
